messages:
devon_marketing: Heads-up: marketing wants a tiny reproducible benchpack for the launch deck and webinar — line we're testing: "roughly 2x lower per-token cost with 4-bit quant + smart batching". Need a defensible smoke by Tue AM. Can runtime run a concise validation?

alex_runtime: We can. Propose 3 cohorts (short <=40, mid ~140, long ~400). Baseline = fp16 tuned; compare with 4-bit quant (initial). Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, coldstart first-token latency, and per-token cost normalized to fp16.

ryan_eng: Warmup plan: 30 short, 10 mid, 5 long. Repeats=4. Concurrency points: 1, 4, 12. Export raw per-request CSV and 5 sample traces per cohort. We'll also include a 2-paragraph plain-language method blurb for the slide notes.

devon_marketing: please call out hardware (1x A100), batch sizes used, and the exact cost formula we can paste into the press pack. Also want a tiny heatmap image of p99 across conc levels.

alex_runtime: noted. Sample payload (use seed=2024 for reproducibility):

```
{"input": "Describe Redwood Inference in two sentences for a webinar slide.", "max_tokens": 80, "temperature": 0.0, "seed": 2024}
```

alex_runtime: Config summary we'll run: repeats=4, cohorts=short,mid,long, conc=1,4,12, metrics csv cols = request_id, cohort, seq_len, latency_ms, tokens_out, model_variant, quant_mode. We'll report mean+std and include raw CSVs. Label quant runs as "initial-quant" unless tuning completes.

bench-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.internal/run/1809998888-smoke. started 1809998950. ETA ~55m.

devon_marketing: legal wants a short safe-harbor sentence; can you include that in the method blurb? Also routing note: inbound leads from the webinar will go to the product demo queue — marketing will include a lead routing tag in the slide.

legal-bot: Suggested safe-harbor: "Benchmarks were run internally on specific hardware and sample inputs; results may vary by workload and deployment." Include model id and batch assumptions.

ryan_eng: Run finished. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1809998888/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csvs + traces + logs). FP16 tuned runs in s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1809998888/fp16_tuned/. 4-bit quant runs are initial: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1809998888/quant4_initial/.

alex_runtime: Quick note: initial quant used default kernels; a short tuning pass (~2h) could improve numbers. If marketing needs tuned quant we can run that and update artifacts, otherwise recommend wording as "about" or "roughly" and mark quant as initial.

devon_marketing: perfect — we'll draft slide copy with conservative wording and include the method blurb + S3 links. If tuned quant artifacts arrive before EOD we'll swap them in; otherwise we'll publish with the initial set and the legal caveat. thanks all! :sparkles:
